changelog:
[COLOR fffdb515]AIOStreams[/COLOR]
-Paid ElfHosted AIOStreams subscriptions can now be linked. These private instances put their own login in front of the account API, so UUID and password never reach AIOStreams there; the manifest URL is what works, and the wizard now links with it even when a UUID and password are also saved.
-Re-detect no longer stops at "HTTP 401" on those instances. Debrid detected explains instead that the instance does not let apps read the account; your sources are not affected.
[COLOR fffdb515]Fixes[/COLOR]
-When only the instance address with UUID and password is given to such an instance, the wizard now says clearly to paste the manifest URL from the Save & Install page, rather than a bare "HTTP 401", and the password is no longer retried inside the address.
-If the instance also blocks the manifest, the wizard says so plainly instead of a generic error.
-The wizard no longer stops on unusual error replies from an instance, and the scraper log points custom-instance users to the manifest URL when it cannot sign in.
